title: Yearly USGS water monitoring agreement
summary: Each year the council takes up a bill letting the mayor sign a joint funding agreement with the U.S. Geological Survey for rainfall, streamflow and groundwater data on Maui and Molokaʻi. The 2025 agreement also funded a study to site a deep monitoring well in West Maui and was deferred in committee. The 2026–27 agreement would cost $225,920, mostly paid by the Department of Water Supply.

timeline.text: The agreement would cost $225,920, with $199,720 from the Department of Water Supply and $26,200 from the U.S. Geological Survey.
The program collects rainfall, streamflow, and groundwater data used to track Maui County water resources on Maui and Molokaʻi.
The agreement covers October 1, 2026 through September 30, 2027.
Bill 134 would let the mayor sign a water monitoring agreement with the U.S. Geological Survey through September 30, 2027.
The chair deferred the item, which means it was set aside for now.
